message.text: Here is a scan of my ID card (KTP) for the admin staff job. Please open it, ma'am.

explanation: The ending on the far right is .scr, which is a program, not an image. A real ID card scan is a .jpg or .pdf, so this file is blocked before anyone opens it.
hints: The ending on the far right decides the file type.
An ID card image is never a program.
